title: ProjectRevisionMetadata
description: Minimum project-snapshot metadata primitive: revisionId (required), optional parentRevisionId, narrow origin (ManualEdit | Recognition | Migration), and a non-empty human-readable summary. NOT a correction log, undo engine, recognition solver, provenance store, or HumanVerified protection. DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the syntactic shape/grammar; self-parent rejection, whitespace-only summary rejection, and exact revision-id semantics are enforced by the core (ProjectRevisionMetadata::from_values / from_json).

parentRevisionId.description: Optional parent snapshot revision. Must not equal revisionId (core rejects self-parent).

summary.description: Non-empty human-readable summary; the core additionally rejects whitespace-only text.
